## History

Joshua Pye was hired to paint the hall for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). After completing the job, it was discovered that he had painted the hall bright blue instead of green because of a mix-up with the paint numbers. His mistake initially devastated the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers), though it ultimately rallied the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in sympathy and support for them against his family.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P15](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0015), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
